== Biography ==
Bessie was born before 1719. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1334|Andrew Glasgow]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-1546]] is assessed at 83% (probable). The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms index entry for Bessie Glasgow, 5 April 1719 at Kirknewton and East Calder (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/13889209), reads the parent fields that the previous review could not see: father Andrew (forenames only). It sits in the Andrew Glasgow and Christian Cook family of Kirknewton attached as Andrew [[Glasgow-1546]], so the father clause now confirms the inherited placement. Confidence rises to 83%.

The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index already cited, so they verify the indexed parent fields rather than adding an independent source; the original register is uninspected. The row names the father only, not the mother. Andrew-1546's own birth (estimated 1685) and upstream father are separate and unchanged. Whether Bessie 1719 and Elizabeth 1717 are distinct children is still open. No mother change follows.
